caption: The video showcases an elaborate layout of multicolored dominoes on a light wood floor, forming loops and arcs around a black slanted ramp on a yellow pedestal. The lower and central loops, plus the row of dominoes laid flat on the ramp, stay still throughout. Within the upper arc, white-topped dominoes tip over one after another, each rotating flat inside its own loop while neighboring pieces stand. The first visible toppling occurs in a small loop at the upper right, after which the falling motion travels leftward from loop to loop. A green loop's marker then rotates flat, followed by a blue, a yellow, and a purple loop, each change confined to a single upright piece. The white-topped domino of the leftmost green loop starts to tip while the cascade is still in progress. The camera holds a fixed overhead view, so the only motion is this steady right-to-left progression of individual dominoes. No hand or other trigger is visible, and the fate of the remaining standing pieces lies beyond the captured frames.
relations: A white-topped domino in the upper right loop tips, initiating a leftward cascade.
The toppling motion travels sequentially through green, blue, yellow, and purple loops.
Lower loops, central loops, and ramp dominoes remain completely stationary.
The fixed overhead view captures only the right-to-left progression of individual dominoes.
